card.name: Verb after an organization's name
card.fires_on: The word right after an organization or publication name used as a subject, such as 'spoke to', 'is not responsible', 'hosted', 'asked', 'welcomes'. It marks the verb or complement slot before an infinitive or object phrase.

modes.label: Reporting speech
modes.description: Preposition after 'spoke' or 'asked' that introduces the person being interviewed or questioned.
modes.example: VOA spoke<< to>> the author of the report, David Anthony

modes.label: Organization disclaimers
modes.description: Adjective or verb after a site or group name, as in 'is not responsible' or 'is fortunate'.
modes.example: JewishGen is not<< responsible>> for inaccuracies or omissions in the

modes.label: Organization actions
modes.description: Verb after a group name describing what it hosts, asks or welcomes.
modes.example: The World Land Trust<< welcomes>> suggestions for new links for our directory.

card.plain: It fires on the word after a group or site name that says what that group does, says or accepts.
